finding.observed_source_behavior: The mutating recovery persistence API accepted caller-supplied checked_at and passed it into active lease validation.
finding.risk: A stale or compromised caller could request lease evaluation against a historical timestamp and thereby weaken expiry as a mutation-time authority boundary.
finding.hypothesis: Mutating recovery authorization must use runtime/SQLite time inside the writer transaction; deterministic time override belongs only to non-mutating verifier tests/audits.
finding.counterhypothesis: All callers may be perfectly trusted to supply current checked_at; this was rejected as a weaker invariant because the persistence boundary itself should enforce freshness.

delta.behavior: persist_recovery_classification_with_canonical_lease now rejects any non-null checked_at with EXTERNAL_CHECKED_AT_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN and invokes the verifier with checked_at=None.
